Hello all — I'd like to fix next week's CSE455 staff meeting. My own week is tightly booked, so the only free windows I have are:

- Monday 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30

- Monday 10:00–10:30 — I'm not free (study group from 10:20).
- Monday 14:00–14:30 — free, I'm clear until the CSE444 lecture at 14:30.
- Tuesday 11:00–11:30 — free (right before lunch).
- Tuesday 15:00–15:30 — free (right after grading).
- Wednesday 10:00–10:30 — free (right after the CSE455 quiz section).
- Wednesday 13:00–13:30 — free.
